description: Set C, written 2026-11-15 BEFORE the model-judged answerability change. 10 everyday-wording answerable questions on topics not used in sets A/B, plus 6 questions the documents cannot answer (they must be refused). Expected locations were looked up in the documents first; the absent topics were confirmed absent (weight, altitude, lead time, stock, AT&T, IP rating: no match; 'warranty' appears only in the copyright disclaimer).
decision_rule: The candidate (hybrid retrieval + model-judged answerability) becomes the default only if, on this set, it answers MORE of C01-C10 correctly than the current default (keyword + word-overlap pre-filter), refuses ALL of C11-C16, and the main and held-out sets stay at 14/14 and 10/10 (including E13, H09, H10 refused).

cases.question: How many general-purpose I/O lines does the module give me?
How fast does the I2C bus run?
cases.expected_behavior: Clock rate of 400 kHz (high-speed mode up to 3.3 Mbps is also stated).

cases.question: How much current does the GPS part use while tracking satellites?
How many modules come on one reel?
What impedance should my antenna feed line be designed for?
What reference voltage does the module put out for level shifting?
Which serial port outputs the debug logs?
What is the highest voltage I can put on the ADC pins?
cases.expected_behavior: The ADC input voltage cannot exceed VBAT.

cases.question: How much current does the module draw in its second sleep level?
Does the module need separate antennas for cellular and GPS?
cases.expected_behavior: Yes: one main antenna and one GNSS antenna interface.

cases.question: What warranty period does Cavli give on the C16QS?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified: no warranty period is stated (only a copyright disclaimer).

cases.question: How much does the C16QS weigh?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified: no weight is stated.

cases.question: What is the lead time for ordering 5,000 C16QS modules?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified: no lead time is stated.

cases.question: Is the C16QS certified for use on the AT&T network?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified: no carrier certification is stated (FCC text is not carrier approval).

cases.question: What IP rating does the C16QS have against dust and water?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified: no IP rating is stated.

cases.question: What is the maximum altitude the module can operate at?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified: no altitude limit is stated.
